decided: When a decision record is replaced, the write gate accepts the replacement's carried citation of a decision whatever that decision's disposition, provided the exploration still holds an entry with that ID; a citation on a record that replaces nothing must still name a live decision, and every other kind of citation is checked as today.
alternatives: check a carried citation of any kind only for equality with the original's
let a replacement re-point a citation of a superseded decision to its successor
why: A carried citation already equals the original's, which passed the live check when written, so the looser check only ever admits a citation that was once valid; it matches what the brief renders, and it extends to citations of decisions the principle behind the spec's rule that a carried link stays as its original wrote it: that rule covers a link whose target record has since been replaced, and until this change said nothing of a decision that was later superseded. Checking for equality alone would let a carried requirement citation point at nothing, which the brief refuses to render; re-pointing would change a link field, which the replacement rule forbids.

relies_on.title: A record is fixed by a replacement, never edited

detail: Option A of the exploration's open question, ratified in chat 2026-11-10 ('A'). The motivating case is ledger-2026-11-09T17-50-54Z.json of seam-chaining.
